prompt: Open the "Block Malicious IP" playbook and add an approval gate before the containment step.

forbidden_facts.label: offered a NEW playbook instead of naming the missing edit affordance

notes: Versatility fixture (assessment Phase 0.3): the ask needs a tool outside the sliced set. The enhance/edit tools (emit_enhancement_offer, verify_enhancement) are build-only, so a triage turn cannot perform this request -- and the one wrong answer is a silent dead-end ('a fully automated edit may not be feasible... please advise', the live .159 failure shape). The capability_gap card exists precisely for this moment: name what is missing and hand the analyst a path forward. After Phase 2 stops hard-slicing, the accepted terminal should widen to the enhance tools themselves.
